pick.name: Probo
pick.what: Open-source compliance platform: controls, risks, vendors (DPA/BAA tracking), policies, public compliance page
pick.why: MIT licence (no AGPL strings), very active, covers SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR/HIPAA/ISO 42001 and includes a trust page
pick.free_limits: Self-host free (Docker Compose/Kubernetes); managed offering exists (pricing not checked)

alts.name: CISO Assistant Community

alts.why: Widest framework library, Windows compose script; AGPL CE

alts.name: Sprinto
alts.why: Pay-later pick: usually cheapest commercial tool (about USD 6-8k/yr per secondary sources) with auditor network

candidates.name: CISO Assistant
candidates.verdict: Pick if you want DPDPA + many frameworks in one place

candidates.name: Comp AI
candidates.verdict: AGPL OSS + quote-based cloud; self-host needs Trigger.dev, Upstash, Google OAuth; last release 2026-08-05

candidates.name: Sprinto
candidates.verdict: Cheapest commercial path when a deal needs SOC 2 fast

decision: Don't buy SOC 2 before a deal requires it. Write policies and collect evidence in Probo now so a Type I takes weeks, not months. When a buyer insists, pick Sprinto or Vanta plus an auditor; the audit fee is separate from the software.
details: Tool prices for Vanta/Drata/Sprinto/Secureframe are from secondary comparison sites; verify with quotes.

verify.note: MIT and probod v0.330.3 (2026-10-28) confirmed. README confirms vendor DPA/BAA tracking, a public compliance page with NDA management, 270+ MCP tools and a CLI. It names SOC 2/GDPR/ISO 27001 plus custom framework import. HIPAA and ISO 42001 aren't named in the README, so treat them as 'via custom framework' unless docs say otherwise.
